20: TOKEN_TTL = int(os.environ.get("TOKEN_TTL", 24 * 3600))
21: 
22: 
23: def get_db():
24:     conn = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE)
25:     conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
26:     return conn

29: def init_db():
30:     with get_db() as conn:
31:         conn.execute(
32:             "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users ("
33:             "  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,"
34:             "  username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,"
35:             "  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL"
36:             ")"
37:         )
38:         conn.execute(
39:             "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks ("
40:             "  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,"
41:             "  title TEXT NOT NULL,"
42:             "  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',"
43:             "  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,"
44:             "  owner_id INTEGER"
45:             ")"
46:         )
47:         # Migration: add owner_id to pre-existing task tables without dropping data.
48:         columns = [row["name"] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(tasks)")]
49:         if "owner_id" not in columns:
50:             conn.execute("ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN owner_id INTEGER")
51:         conn.commit()

59: def create_user(username: str, password: str) -> dict:
60:     password_hash = bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode("utf-8")
61:     with get_db() as conn:
62:         cursor = conn.execute(
63:             "INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash) VALUES (?, ?)",
64:             (username, password_hash),
65:         )
66:         conn.commit()
67:         return {
68:             "id": cursor.lastrowid,
69:             "username": username,
70:             "password_hash": password_hash,
71:         }
72: 
73: 
74: def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
75:     with get_db() as conn:
76:         row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone()
77:         return dict(row) if row else None
78: 
79: 
80: def get_user_by_username(username: str) -> dict | None:
81:     with get_db() as conn:
82:         row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?", (username,)).fetchone()
83:         return dict(row) if row else None

87:     user = get_user_by_username(username)
88:     if user is None:

90:     if not bcrypt.checkpw(password.encode("utf-8"), user["password_hash"].encode("utf-8")):
91:         return None
92:     return user

94: 
95: def make_token(user_id: int) -> str:
96:     payload = {
97:         "user_id": user_id,
98:         "iat": int(time.time()),
99:         "exp": int(time.time()) + TOKEN_TTL,
100:     }
101:     return jwt.encode(payload, SECRET_KEY, algorithm="HS256")

104: def get_auth_user() -> dict | None:
105:     header = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
106:     if not header.startswith("Bearer "):
107:         return None
108:     token = header[len("Bearer "):].strip()
109:     try:
110:         payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=["HS256"])
111:     except jwt.PyJWTError:

163: def update_task(task_id: int, owner_id: int, title: str | None = None, status: str | None = None) -> dict | None:
164:     task = get_task(task_id, owner_id)
165:     if task is None:

173:         if status is not None:

181:             )

import os
import time

import pytest


@pytest.fixture()
def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("DATABASE", str(tmp_path / "test.db"))
    import importlib
    import app as app_module

    app_module = importlib.reload(app_module)
    app_module.init_db()
    app_module.app.config["TESTING"] = True
    return app_module.app.test_client()


@pytest.fixture()
def auth(client):
    def register(username="alice", password="secret123"):
        return client.post("/auth/register", json={"username": username, "password": password})

    def login(username="alice", password="secret123"):
        return client.post("/auth/login", json={"username": username, "password": password})

    def token(username="alice", password="secret123"):
        rv = login(username, password)
        assert rv.status_code == 200
        return rv.get_json()["token"]

    def headers(username="alice", password="secret123"):
        return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token(username, password)}"}

    register()
    return {
        "register": register,
        "login": login,
        "token": token,
        "headers": headers,
    }


def post_task(client, title, username="alice", password="secret123"):
    return client.post(
        "/tasks",
        json={"title": title},
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {auth_token(client, username, password)}"},
    )


def auth_token(client, username, password):
    rv = client.post("/auth/login", json={"username": username, "password": password})
    assert rv.status_code == 200
    return rv.get_json()["token"]


# ── Auth: register ────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_register_creates_user(client):
    rv = client.post("/auth/register", json={"username": "bob", "password": "hunter2"})
    assert rv.status_code == 201
    data = rv.get_json()
    assert data["id"] > 0
    assert data["username"] == "bob"
    assert "password_hash" not in data


def test_register_missing_fields_returns_400(client):
    rv = client.post("/auth/register", json={})
    assert rv.status_code == 400
    rv = client.post("/auth/register", json={"username": "bob"})
    assert rv.status_code == 400
    rv = client.post("/auth/register", json={"username": "   ", "password": "x"})
    assert rv.status_code == 400


def test_register_duplicate_username_returns_409(client, auth):
    rv = auth["register"]()
    assert rv.status_code == 409


# ── Auth: login ───────────────────────────────────────────────

def test_login_returns_token(client, auth):
    rv = auth["login"]()
    assert rv.status_code == 200
